# runr_region (Data Source)

A region (Kubernetes cluster with Knative) projects run in. Look it up by `name` or `id`; with neither, the only active region is returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runr_region" "eu" {
  name = "eu-1"
}

# With neither name nor id: the only active region.
data "runr_region" "default" {}

output "queues_available" {
  value = data.runr_region.eu.has_redis
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Region id.
- `name` (String) Region name.

### Read-Only

- `has_redis` (Boolean) Redis is configured (needed by queue triggers).
- `is_active` (Boolean) Projects can be deployed to it.
- `is_demo` (Boolean) Demo region (deployments are simulated).
- `status` (String) Region status (`active`, `maintenance`, …).
